significance: A Vishnu temple in Tiruchirappalli district where the deity is enshrined in a reclining posture with Vedanayaki, built up under the medieval Cholas and later the Vijayanagara kings. Its chariot festival falls in the Tamil month of Chittirai.
story: An Araiyar of Thiru Naraiyur is said to have given his own life and those of his children to shield the deity from a fire in the temple, and Narayana granted the family liberation.
